capabilities: Detect pasted code and wrap it in a fenced block with the detected language
Add copy, run, change-language and save-as-file buttons to code blocks
Run a block or line in a terminal, filling placeholders and confirming risky commands
Edit code files in a CodeMirror editor with highlighting, search and a read-only lock
Preview HTML files in a sandboxed frame beside the note
extras: Desktop only (macOS, Windows, Linux). The plugin makes no network requests; HTML preview cannot load other vault files, so adjacent images and stylesheets are not shown, and JavaScript and network access are off by default. Interface available in English and Turkish.
problem: Pasted snippets arrive as plain text, and Obsidian offers no way to run commands, edit code files or preview HTML from a note.

relations.evidence: Run in terminal (needs ecu-terminal): sends a block or the current line to the terminal

summary: Adds code handling to notes: paste detection into fenced blocks, block buttons, a code file editor and sandboxed HTML preview.
